# testdata/library

Hand-written fixtures for the end-to-end tests in `crates/library/tests/library.rs` and
`crates/cli/tests/cli.rs`: `archive.mbox` and the `eml/` folder together form one
conversation ("Project kickoff") whose messages live in different sources, plus a
forwarded message with an attachment. All participants use the reserved `stv.test`
domain. Covered by the project license.
